name: E-Tafkeek — TAFKEEK e-Waste Recycling
address: Mecca Street, Al Husseini complex 152, 4th floor, office 402
process: Call the mobile number and tell them roughly how many devices you have.
Send pictures of the devices so they can estimate the load.
They send a car to your location to collect the components.
accepts: Motherboards, PC cards and PCB boards
services: Free pickup by car after a call and photos (confirm timing when you call)
Refurbished computers and usable parts (hard drives, optical drives, RAM)
Non-recycled boards (motherboards, PC cards, PCB) for export
Legal disposal supporting the MOENV 100 JOD/ton fee policy
notes: You do not need to travel to the office: call the mobile, describe the rough count, and send photos — they arrange a car to your location. The two +962 6 numbers are landlines for the office. Ask what happens to data-bearing drives before handing anything over.
